name: ANSI/IEEE single-phase bridge rectifier symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for single-phase bridge rectifier, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The bridge-rectifier form identifies a multi-junction AC-to-DC arrangement with separate AC inputs and polarised DC output. This original four-branch diagram illustrates the connection principle; rectifier rating and any smoothing or regulation remain separate specifications.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace both AC inputs and both DC outputs.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A rectifier bridge supplies rectified output; it is not automatically a regulated DC power supply.
